title: TunnelError
description: Data payload of the tunnel.open JSON-RPC error. A bind on a local port somebody else already holds carries the typed cause `address-in-use`, so the renderer opens the same forward again on an allocated port from that cause and never from the message — prose the backend may reword. Every other failure (an unresolvable profile, a refused connection, an invalid destination, a permission error) carries no data at all: a retry on another port cannot help it.

reason.description: Fixed cause vocabulary. `address-in-use` is the only value today: the requested local port is held, and port 0 is the remedy the renderer applies exactly once.
